**Finding submitted — deviation (MINCOMMIT).**

- **Offending clause:** § 2.1 (p0012) — USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay for three years, "without reduction or termination rights." This is squarely in walk-away territory and fails all three fallback elements (no 12-month limit, no 30-day reduction right, no true-up).
- **Conflict noted:** § 12.3 (p0044) has Vendor acknowledge Customer made no minimum-volume commitment — directly inconsistent with § 2.1.
- **Cure (preferred level, single surgical replace):** § 2.1 now reads "Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment." The second preferred element is already met verbatim by § 7.1 (payment of Fees stated in each Order Form, with usage-based unit pricing), so nothing further was added.
- **Swept for other exposure:** no volume caps or shortfall penalties elsewhere; the § 22.2/22.3 "shortfall" language runs against Vendor underpayments and benefits us.
